dei.evidence: We are investing $300 million in our Diversity in Technology Initiative to achieve full representation of women and under-represented minorities at Intel by 2020

innovation.evidence: We believe technology must constantly evolve to make more things possible and all things easier, smarter, and more connected than ever before.

result.analyst_notes: Brief page dominated by site chrome, recruiting prompts and rankings, which are not coded. The only substantive commitment is a dated, funded diversity investment with a numeric target. The innovation statement uses first-person plural 'We believe' and is aspirational rather than measured. Few stakeholders are addressed beyond these two statements.
